Simple Present and Simple Past (Review)
You use the simple present to talk about routines and schedules. The simple past tense is used to talk about finished actions.
I got this article that describes the opportunities and challenges that a business owner found in his career.
How was I supposed to know?
We have some new challenges now.
These two tenses present similarities except when you use verb to be, which does not need and auxiliary verb. For the rest of the verbs, you use auxiliaries for questions and negative sentences.

Examples:
We didn't have effective customer response, but with the implementation of a proper Information system, we have a great customer response nowadays.

How to Explore New Opportunities
When thinking about new opportunities, you need to take into account your personal motivations as well as those of your company to make the best of them.
We have some new challenges now. For example, how to keep customers loyalty, how to improve their satisfaction and how to maintain innovation to attract new customers.

In the personal level, you need to focus on the things that motivate you in order to find a way to expand your horizons. In this aspect, you should think about yourself and the world of work. Knowing about the way it works and adapting to its requirements and characteristics will be an advantage to you. Next, think about the positions that you'd like to occupy, for example a web or program designer. And finally, think of strategies to help you reach your objectives, like saving money or studying more.

images.text: I got this article that describes the opportunities and challenges that a business owner found in his career. Let's read it, I need to write a report on this topic and I think this reading might help.

In my experience I found many obstacles and I had to overcome them by being successful, especially with the advent of technology, things like doing an inventory have become easier thanks to dedicated software. One of the biggest difficulties I faced was the decision of which system was the most appropriate for my business. There is a myriad of choices in the market, and you need to try to figure out which is the right one for you in terms of size, convenience, and efficiency for your kind of business. Right after that, I could see that I had to invest in personnel training, which was not cheap and it also took a while.</br>
I decided to take the risk because I didn't know if it would be an investment I could recover. How was I supposed to know?

Fortunately for me, my business has grown greatly. The system I decided to use, allows us to control not only the inventory but also CRM, which has become an essential part of our customer care program. It was something we didn't pay much attention to at first, but it has changed our way of doing business and we have some new challenges now. For example, how to keep customers' loyalty, how to improve their satisfaction and how to maintain innovation to attract new customers.</br>
My advice to all business owners is to take the risk, but an informed and planned one. In business, challenges often bring new opportunities to improve.
